summary.text: Son of Phyleus, peer of Ares, who led the folk of Dulichium and the holy Echinae isles in forty black ships to Troy.

story.text: Homer reckons Meges among the foremost spearmen of the Achaean host — Phyleus' son, famed for his spear, who in battle drove his bronze through an enemy's jaw. Agamemnon would have him roused with Diomedes and Odysseus for the night ambush against the Trojans.
